程序包 top.gxde.ai.core

类 CoreClient

java.lang.Object
top.gxde.ai.core.CoreClient
所有已实现的接口:
AutoCloseable
public final class CoreClient extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Talks to gxde-ai-core over its UNIX socket.

Every call throws StatusRuntimeException when the server rejects the request or cannot be reached.

      public gxde.ai.agent.Account.AgentAccount createAccount(gxde.ai.agent.Account.AgentAccount account)

      public gxde.ai.agent.Account.ModelDescriptor addModel(String accountId, gxde.ai.agent.Account.ModelDescriptor model)

    • updateModel

      public gxde.ai.agent.Account.ModelDescriptor updateModel(String accountId, gxde.ai.agent.Account.ModelDescriptor model, com.google.protobuf.FieldMask mask)
      Replaces the fields of the model with the same ID that are named in mask.
      参数:
      accountId - ID of the account that owns the model
      model - the model to change, identified by its ID, holding the new values
      mask - the fields to replace, such as token_limits.context_window_tokens
      返回:
      the model as stored after the update

    • deleteModel

      public void deleteModel(String accountId, String modelId)
      Removes the model with modelId from the account with accountId.
      参数:
      accountId - ID of the account that owns the model
      modelId - ID of the model to remove

    • searchModels

      public List<gxde.ai.agent.AccountServiceOuterClass.ModelMatch> searchModels(String query, String accountId)
      Returns models whose ID, display name or UUID contains query, ignoring case. An empty accountId searches every account.
      参数:
      query - text to look for; an empty query matches every model
      accountId - ID of the account to search, or an empty string for all accounts
      返回:
      the matching models with the IDs of the accounts that own them

    • getModelByUuid

      Returns the model with uuid and the account that owns it.
      参数:
      uuid - UUID the server assigned to the model
      返回:
      the model and its owning account, without the account's other models
